parameters.name: sizePage
parameters.description: Items per page. Use `0` to retrieve only the count without fetching any item — faster when you only need the total.

schema.description:
State of a discount.

* `Draft` — not yet active
* `Enabled` — active and applicable
schema.title: StateDiscount

schema.description:
Which fee type a discount applies to.

* `FlatFee` — applied to the flat recurring fee
* `FeatureFee` — applied to feature charges
* `UpfrontFee` — applied to the upfront/setup fee
* `AllRecurring` — applied to all recurring charges
* `All` — applied to all fees
schema.title: TargetFee

parameters.name: countPeriods
parameters.description: Filter by number of periods the discount applies.
